source_selector.selection: the complete single retained JSON document

json_contract.unknown_or_missing_keys: reject; exact keys and source key order are required
json_contract.array_order: preserve source order and each parent/ordinal; never sort or deduplicate
json_contract.chapter_and_verse_numbers: positive consecutive JSON integers in source array order; booleans are not integers
json_contract.text_values: strings only; preserve exact Unicode scalar sequences, leading and trailing whitespace, and literal markup characters without parsing or normalization
json_contract.empty_text_values: preserve as present empty strings on present verse carriers; only the three profile-listed source loci are expected
json_contract.missing_null_or_other_text_types: reject and identify the source pointer; do not substitute text from another source or projection
json_contract.empty_arrays: reject at every declared books/chapters/verses collection

mapping.translation: Copy /translation verbatim to a TEI source-description bibl labeled as a retained source label; do not infer edition, date, translator, or work boundary.
mapping.book: One TEI book div per source book object, in source array order; source name is the head text and is not mapped through a separate Bible-name table.
mapping.chapter: One TEI chapter div per source chapter object, in source array order; preserve the exact numeric label.
mapping.verse: One TEI ab per source verse object, in source array order; preserve the exact numeric label and decoded text value.
mapping.empty_text_carriers: Emit the verse ab even when its text is empty. The node's presence preserves the source carrier; the accounting record separately records that /text was present and empty. Do not insert a gap, wording, or status inferred from another witness.
mapping.xml_space: Set xml:space=preserve on every verse ab so meaningful leading/trailing whitespace remains explicit.
mapping.tei_title: Use the profile's generic title; retain the source translation label separately without promoting it to verified bibliographic identity.
mapping.source_note: Place the limitation notice in a notesStmt note; keep sourceDesc limited to the source-supplied translation label.

required_inventory: source member path, byte count, and SHA-256
source selector and exact translation field value
all 1,189 ordered chapter carriers with their verse counts
all 31,102 ordered verse carriers with parent position, exact label, text state, and exact text-value SHA-256
the three present empty-text carriers with explicit carrier-present and text-field-present states
accountability.independent_comparison: The oracle separately reads the retained JSON, derives its own complete ledger, validates the ledger schema, and compares the actual TEI tree directly with source order and values.

downstream_segmentation.role: diagnostic only; not a source authority, selector, producer input, oracle input, or completeness oracle
downstream_segmentation.warning: The generated per-book projection omits the three empty source text values and may normalize source strings. A generated completeness label does not alter this policy.

identity_and_rights.work_id: darby is the pre-existing route key only; broader work boundary remains unresolved
identity_and_rights.edition_and_lineage: unresolved; do not interpret the source label's parenthetical year as verified edition evidence
identity_and_rights.rights_and_attribution: not assessed; the legacy config's rights label is not adopted as proof

shared_assumptions: Python's JSON decoder, with duplicate-key rejection independently applied in each route
manifest-bound source bytes and the shared SourceManifest contract
the declared TEI P5 schema and its local XML schema imports
the shared final MechanicalFacts attestation assembler

candidate.title: Retained Bible translation text
candidate.publication_notice: Source-bound reconstruction output only; this route makes no acceptance, rights, release, or publication claim.
candidate.source_note: The exact retained translation label is source-supplied metadata. Its wording and parenthetical year are preserved as a label only, not asserted as resolved edition or publication evidence.
candidate.scope: The complete ordered envelope of the one exact retained JSON member; not a complete-print or bibliographic-witness claim.
candidate.readme:
# Darby retained-source reconstruction route

This route is bound to the complete retained JSON document `raw/bible_databases/formats/json/Darby.json` (SHA-256 `6e5c9816b945fa5adef7c1ba419f4ddbca5fff3f77263284697e928a0841f806`). It preserves the source's `translation` field, ordered books, chapters, verse carriers, and exact text values, including present empty strings. The per-book JSON files under `data/bible-text/darby` are downstream diagnostics and are not reconstruction authority.

The retained label is not independent evidence of edition identity or date. Work boundary, textual form, translator attribution, rights, and source lineage remain unresolved or unassessed. This technical route does not establish human acceptance, release, or publication authorization.

unresolved.question: Does this exact retained JSON scope establish the same standalone work and translation/textual form as the existing darby catalog route key?
What bibliographic edition and digital lineage, if any, are established by primary-source evidence beyond the retained translation label?
Which work-specific evidence supports translator attribution for this exact retained text?
What rights and attribution terms apply separately to the underlying work, translation, edition, transcription, database, and retained source?
Coordinator review, candidate packaging, exact-pair visual review, and any human acceptance decision remain separate future work.

mutation_cases_rejected: omit a source verse carrier, including one of the three present empty-text carriers
reorder or duplicate a book, chapter, or verse carrier
invent a carrier or change a numeric label
alter, trim, normalize, or replace any exact verse string
alter or omit the retained translation label
